percentile_note: ANSUR II male mean; the 50th percentile differs by at most 0.5 mm in the dimensions used

sources.A: ANSUR II male working database (Gordon et al. 2014, NATICK/TR-15/007), n = 4,082; mean and percentiles recomputed on 2026-11-17 from the public CSV (ANSUR_II_MALE_Public.csv, Penn State OpenLab mirror)
sources.B: Buryanov & Kotiuk 2010, Int. J. Morphol. 28(3):755-758, Table I (X-ray, 66 adults, both sexes); values carried over from the paused build, table not re-read this session (the publisher blocked the request)
sources.H: Hsiao, Whitestone, Kau & Hildreth 2015, Human Factors 57(8):1359-1377, firefighter hand anthropometry, men; values carried over from the paused build, table not re-read this session

rows.dimension: hand length (stylion to tip of digit III)
rows.how: skeleton: wrist offset + bone lengths; the 1.04 scale on B was set to give this

rows.dimension: hand breadth (across the metacarpal heads)
rows.how: widest ring of the palm shell, less 2 x glove

rows.dimension: hand circumference (round the metacarpal heads)
rows.how: perimeter of the palm shell ring at 80 % of the palm, less 2 pi x glove; the section exponent (3.8) was tuned to this with the 29.5 mm thickness held

rows.dimension: wrist circumference
rows.how: perimeter of the palm shell ring at the wrist joint, less 2 pi x glove; the half-axes 30.8 x 21.4 mm were tuned to this

rows.dimension: palm length (wrist crease to the crease of digit III)
rows.how: MCP III + 19.2 mm crease offset (set to give this)

rows.dimension: forearm (radiale to stylion)
rows.how: forearm bone length

rows.dimension: index finger length (base to tip), scaled to the 195.5 mm hands of H
rows.how: MCP to tip less a base offset of 13.8 mm fitted on the middle finger

rows.dimension: middle finger length (base to tip), scaled to the 195.5 mm hands of H

rows.dimension: ring finger length (base to tip), scaled to the 195.5 mm hands of H

rows.dimension: little finger length (base to tip), scaled to the 195.5 mm hands of H
rows.how: MCP to tip less a base offset of 13.8 mm fitted on the middle finger

rows.dimension: thumb length (MCP joint to tip), scaled to the hands of H
rows.how: H's thumb base landmark is not the joint centre; no tolerance set
